independent_synthetic_math.method: SciPy NB pmf/sf/shifted first moments; independent numpy coefficient convolution; exhaustive five-Bernoulli DD/TD configurations
independent_synthetic_math.source:
import itertools,math,json
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import nbinom
from multisport_lab.count_support import NegativeBinomial2,_coefficients,_threshold_probability,_double_triple_probabilities,TERMS,CountDistribution
from multisport_lab.baseline import COUNT_FIELDS
checks=0;maximum=0.
for scale in [.02,.2,1.,4.,12.]:
 means={name:scale*(1+i/8) for i,name in enumerate(COUNT_FIELDS)}
 primitives={name:NegativeBinomial2(mu) for name,mu in means.items()}
 for name,nb in primitives.items():
  p=2/(2+means[name])
  for n in [0,1,9,40,100]:
   for a,b in [(nb.pmf(n),nbinom.pmf(n,2,p)),(nb.sf(n),nbinom.sf(n,2,p)),
               (nb.first_tail_moment(n),means[name]*nbinom.sf(n-1,3,p))]:
    difference=abs(a-b);maximum=max(maximum,difference);checks+=1
    assert math.isclose(a,b,rel_tol=2e-11,abs_tol=1e-13),(scale,name,n,a,b)
 for market,terms in TERMS.items():
  truth=np.array([1.])
  upper=160
  for name,a in terms:
   pmf=nbinom.pmf(np.arange(upper//a+1),2,2/(2+means[name]))
   expanded=np.zeros(a*(len(pmf)-1)+1);expanded[::a]=pmf
   truth=np.convolve(truth,expanded)[:upper+1]
  actual=_coefficients(terms,primitives,upper)
  for n,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(actual,truth)):
   difference=abs(a-b);maximum=max(maximum,difference);checks+=1
   assert math.isclose(a,b,rel_tol=2e-11,abs_tol=1e-13),(scale,market,n,a,b)
 pts=_threshold_probability(TERMS['PTS'],primitives)
 low=_coefficients(TERMS['PTS'],primitives,9)
 checks+=1
 assert abs(pts-(1-math.fsum(low)))<1e-12
 probabilities=[pts]+[float(nbinom.sf(9,2,2/(2+means[name]))) for name in ['rebounds','assists','steals','blocks']]
 binary=_double_triple_probabilities(primitives)
 for m,k in [('DD',2),('TD',3)]:
  truth=math.fsum(math.prod(p if b else 1-p for p,b in zip(probabilities,bits)) for bits in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=5) if sum(bits)>=k)
  checks+=1;maximum=max(maximum,abs(truth-binary[m][1]))
  assert math.isclose(truth,binary[m][1],rel_tol=2e-11,abs_tol=1e-14)
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS_INDEPENDENT_SYNTHETIC_MATH','checks':checks,'maximum_absolute_difference':maximum,'scipy':'independent_review_only_not_runtime_dependency','target_outcomes_scored':0}))
